The '''R-2000 Raptor speeder bike''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]]. It was an attempt to create a speeder bike with the performance and style of a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]. The [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was barely more than an engine and control vanes, and the pilot was perched at the very end of the chassis. This increased performance by allowing a larger engine with a higher heat exhaust and gave the pilot more leverage with which to steer the bike. The basic design for the R-2000 was completed during the Imperial Era, but the prototypes were unsafe to drive and a usable design was only created after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="A&E" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Although more rarer than the Ikas-Adno's [[22-B Nightfalcon]],<ref name="Threats" /> the R-2000 Raptor enjoyed increased popularity with time<ref name="A&E" /> and could ultimately be found in almost every known sector of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At some point, a modified R-2000 was driven by a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] leader while on the run.<ref name="Threats" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ull Murub was introduced in the [[2002]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="A&E" /> and first pictured in the [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="Threats" /> The speeder's artwork for the book was drawn by [[Mark Tedin]]<ref name="TedinFile">{{WookCite|url=File:Nikto_Swoop_Gang_Leader.jpg?oldid=2180419|text=January 29, 2008 revision of File:Nikto Swoop Gang Leader.jpg}}</ref> under a contract with [[Lucasfilm]] and Wizards of the Coast.<ref name="Bantha68">{{WookCite|url=User_talk:Bantha68|text=User talk page for {{U|Bantha68}}}}</ref>
